title: On Cancelling the whole visit at the last hour
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：cancel　|　正文 362 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cancel 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the cook ① cancelled the whole visit at the last hour before dawn, and every guest in the canteen said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the cook ② cancels the whole visit at the last hour in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cancel the whole visit at the last hour at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cancelled the whole visit at the last hour before — a line in the menu for September 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Cancelling the whole visit at the last hour before dawn, the cook said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cancel the old debt in the book in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cancel the old debt in the book at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the menu, and a new guest from the next canteen ⑧ cancels the old debt in the book before dawn every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the table, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cancelled the whole visit at the last hour again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cancel the whole visit at the last hour, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the canteen remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the canteen forgets, somebody cancels the whole visit at the last hour in public again and somebody must cancel the whole visit at the last hour before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 取消（一般过去式 cancelled the whole visit at the last hour：1978 年厨子头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 取消（一般现在 cancels the whole visit at the last hour：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 取消（不定式 to cancel the whole visit at the last hour：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 取消（过去完成时 had cancelled the whole visit at the last hour：1972 年九月的菜单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 取消（动名词 cancelling the whole visit at the last hour 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 注销（cancel the old debt in the book：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去注销簿子上那笔旧账）
G. v. 注销（cancel the old debt in the book：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 取消（后段两处：新来的客人照例 cancels the old debt in the book，而母亲又一次 cancelled the whole visit at the last hour）

answers.why: cancel 意为“取消”，1978 年厨子天没亮就取消最后一刻取消整次拜访，那是食堂里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 cancelled。
cancel 意为“取消”，自那以后厨子当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 cancels。
cancel 意为“取消”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯取消最后一刻取消整次拜访”，此处为不定式 to cancel the whole visit at the last hour。
cancel 意为“取消”，菜单里 九月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人取消过，故用过去完成时 had cancelled。
cancel 意为“取消”，厨子说“取消最后一刻取消整次拜访这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 cancelling the whole visit at the last hour 作主语。
cancel 意为“注销”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去注销簿子上那笔旧账”，should ever 之后用原形 cancel the old debt in the book。
cancel 意为“注销”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻注销簿子上那笔旧账（cancel the old debt in the book at once），以后再也不要提起。
cancel 意为“取消”，新来的客人每个日子都照例注销簿子上那笔旧账，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 cancels。
cancel 意为“取消”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就取消最后一刻取消整次拜访，用一般过去式 cancelled 叙述。
cancel 意为“取消”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要取消最后一刻取消整次拜访，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和食堂记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cancel 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the cook cancelled the whole visit at the last hour before dawn, and nobody in the canteen forgot it.
Even now the cook cancels the whole visit at the last hour in public whenever the canteen asks.
Cancelling the whole visit at the last hour before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cancel the old debt in the book in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new guest from the next canteen cancels the old debt in the book before dawn every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cancelled the whole visit at the last hour again, and the canteen remembered that half.
